title: Irrefutable Patterns and Ignoring
goal: Unpack tuples and arrays while ignoring unneeded elements.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: Irrefutable Patterns

sections.text: You unpack tuples or arrays in Python and JavaScript with simple assignment. Rust uses `let` statements to destructure compound types.

sections.caption: let matches the shape on the right.

sections.text: A `let` pattern must be irrefutable. That means it must match every possible value of the type, or the compiler stops with `E0005`.

sections.caption: .. ignores any number of middle elements.

sections.text: Use `_` to ignore a single element. Use `..` to ignore all remaining elements between items.

explanation: Unpack tuples and arrays while ignoring unneeded elements.
